verdict.rationale: Railway's own site says you can "Create custom dashboards with metrics from any service," which matches the story directly. The only support is that single marketing line, with no in-depth docs or hands-on confirmation. Missing for 10: detailed documentation of dashboard building (widget types, available metrics, combining across services and environments), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
